THE BUILD

The thinking behind the page.

A useful project has to connect its interface to the visitor’s task.

Audience

People who need a clear path into Pro Resume Builder and an interface they can understand quickly.

Experience

Helping users move from raw career information to a readable layout.

Next iteration

Review real visitor feedback and refine the areas where people hesitate or need more context.

Interface decisions

A resume builder has to help people choose what to include, not just decorate the final page.

What I would keep refining

Live preview can make formatting decisions easier, but the entered information should remain readable and easy to edit at each step.
